items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She’s sitting over in the wings.

ctx.x: Yeah. She’s sitting over in the wings. You know how Miles used to act. He had a different act altogether. He was playing like nursery rhymes [Freeman sings a ditty]. Then he’d smile at her. “Come on, give us some sugar” or something. Then he – and something was wrong with his leg.
